name: ViaBill Payments
description: A ViaBill payment gateway for Drupal Commerce.
project_description:
The ViaBill Payments module integrates ViaBill with Drupal Commerce, enabling merchants to offer flexible "Buy Now, Pay Later" (BNPL) payment plans. It allows customers to split their payments into monthly installments, making purchases more accessible while helping merchants increase conversion rates and average order values.

 This module is ideal for merchants who want to give their customers access to interest-free or low-interest financing options, directly at checkout.

 Features 
 + Seamless integration with Drupal Commerce.

+ Adds ViaBill as a payment gateway during checkout.

+ Secure payment redirection to ViaBill’s hosted payment page.

+ Displays ViaBill monthly installment pricing info directly on product and cart pages (optional).

 Use cases:

+ Merchants who want to offer a "Buy Now, Pay Later" option in Denmark or Spain.

+ E-commerce stores looking to reduce cart abandonment and improve affordability for customers.

+ Online stores with customers who prefer to split purchases over monthly payments without using credit cards.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module:

1. Navigate to Commerce > Configuration > Payment gateways.

2. Add a new payment gateway of type ViaBill Payments

3. Enter your API credentials from your ViaBill merchant account. If you don't have these account credentials yet, you can register to create a new ViaBill account.

4. Configure test/live mode, supported currencies, and transaction type preferences (authorize only, authorize and capture payments).

5. Optionally, insert the ViaBill pricetags into the product, cart and checkout templates.

 Additional Requirements 
 1. Drupal Commerce module.

2. A valid ViaBill merchant account (login or signup) to retrieve the API credentials from ViaBill.

3. Merchant needs to have a valid business address in Denmark or Spain.

4. Supported currencies must match your ViaBill account settings.
